attention2.ptxt: Exhaust gas temperature from the muffler tail pipe becomes higher excessively when after-sales regeneration is in operation. Failure to take proper precautions may result in a fire and personal injury.
Take the following precautions to reduce the risk of a fire and injury.

item.ptxt: Locate the vehicle in a well-ventilated outdoor area.
Do not allow a person to come near the muffler tail pipe.
Do not leave obstruction or inflammable material in the vicinity of exhaust system components.

attention4.ptxt: Stopping after-sales regeneration before it is completed may damage the GPF due to thermal shock.
When after-sales regeneration is in operation, do not cancel the process through to the end without interruption.

item.ptxt: For details of SUZUKI scan tool, refer to its Operator’s Manual.
After ECM is replaced with new one, perform the GPF regeneration.
Under any of the following conditions, after-sales regeneration is canceled.

s1.ptxt: Check that fuel level is 1/4 full or more.
Locate vehicle in a well-ventilated outdoor area.
When ignition is “OFF”, connect SUZUKI scan tool to DLC.
If DTCs other than P2463 or P24A4 are detected, repair the malfunction according to applicable DTC troubleshooting.
Warm up engine to normal operating temperature.
Select “Regeneration” in “Utility” menu, and follow instructions displayed on SUZUKI scan tool.
After-sales regeneration is automatically performed as follows:

s2.ptxt: Engine speed is kept to idle speed to warm GPF.

attention3.ptxt: Idle speed is maintained according to engine condition. When engine condition for regeneration is met, after-sales regeneration shifts to phase 2.

s2.ptxt: Engine speed is raised to approx. 2,550 rpm and regeneration is started.

attention3.ptxt: Phase 2 will last for 80 to 120 minutes. This period depends on soot deposit in GPF.

s2.ptxt: Engine speed decreases to idle speed.

s1.ptxt: Check that display of SUZUKI scan tool shows “Regeneration is completed”.
If not, repair faulty condition according to After-Sales Regeneration Failure .
Set ignition “OFF”, and wait for 60 seconds or more.
If DTCs other than P2463 or P24A4 are detected, repair the malfunction according to applicable DTC troubleshooting.
